response.original_title: The Guy Who Didn't Like Musicals
response.overview: The Guy Who Didn't Like Musicals is a horror-comedy stage musical by StarKid Productions about an alien hive mind that turns the town of Hatchetfield into a singing-and-dancing apocalypse, forcing an ordinary man who hates musicals to fight for survival.
response.tagline: In Hatchetfield, no one can hear you scream—because they're too busy harmonizing
